newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble weaker as funds could come from T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Rouble weaker as funds could come from T-bills.

text.p: The rouble eased on Thursday as funds came from the Treasury bill market after Wednesday's sales and dealers client buying was less active than in previous days.
roubles/dollar Apr 3 midday Apr 3 early Apr 2 close
"The dollar is firmer as some funds came to the market after yesterday's auctions," said Dmitry Tyurnin of Rossiisky Kredit Bank.
On Wednesday the finance ministry auctioned seven trillion roubles of 203-day GKO discount Treasury bills (series 22079) and four trillion roubles of 728-day OFZ government interest-bearing bonds.
Neftekhimbank dealer Vladimir Zrazhevsky said banks could also need less roubles after they had squared quarter-end balance sheets.
